IC1: 1. Presence of bacteremia due solely to:
IC2: S. aureus on at least 1 blood culture within 72 hours of beginning study drug (Cohort A) OR
IC3: MRSA on a baseline blood culture and on at least 1 additional blood culture after at least 72 hours of vancomycin [OR] and/or daptomycin treatment (Cohort B).
IC4: 2. Male [OR] or female ≥ 18 years of age.
IC5: 3. If female of childbearing potential must be willing to practice sexual abstinence [OR] or dual methods of contraception during treatment and for at least 30 days after the last dose of study drug.
IC6: 4. Expectation of survival for at least 2 months.
